task_description: Issue #273 (Phase 2 of epic #267): a smoke suite that can run against a deployed URL. Rework scripts/smoke-redirect.sh so the same assertions run against localhost, the composed stack, or a deployed CDN-fronted environment: (1) base-URL mode via API/RD with the link creation domain derived from RD (or explicit LINK_DOMAIN) instead of hardcoded localhost:3002; (2) self-created fixtures cleaned up via a bash EXIT trap that DELETEs every created link even on mid-run failure, so it is safe to point at a real environment; (3) the direct-DB (psql/docker exec) assertions gated to when DB access exists (local/CI/compose), with always-run API-based equivalents so deployed mode verifies the same facts through the public surface; (4) the three CDN-only assertions run in all modes -- a real slug returns 302 not 404, a country-scoped routing rule matches, and click_events.country is populated (verified in deployed mode by polling GET /analytics?linkId=...&range=24h for the country breakdown, driven with a non-bot UA + CloudFront-Viewer-Country header, within the worker rollup poll budget ~90s). Then wire it as a post-deploy gate via a reusable .github/workflows/smoke-deployed.yml (workflow_call + workflow_dispatch) that runs the script against a target and fails on non-zero, plus docs. There is no deploy workflow yet (Phase 7 #288/#289 sequences it), so the deliverable is the runnable URL-targetable tool + the callable hook + docs, not a fake pipeline. The existing verify.yml `verify` and compose `integration` jobs (which run smoke-redirect.sh with DATABASE_URL set and RD=http://localhost:3002) must stay green. Docker cannot run in this sandbox, so the full composed run is validated by the `integration` CI job on the PR.

verification.summary: Bash + YAML only change; no app code touched. `bash -n` passes on scripts/smoke-redirect.sh (and integration-assertions.sh unchanged). Both workflows parse as valid YAML (PyYAML). .github/workflows/verify.yml is byte-for-byte unchanged (git diff --stat HEAD~2 empty for it), so the existing `verify` and compose `integration` jobs are unaffected. No env-dump patterns in smoke-deployed.yml. LINK_DOMAIN default derivation confirmed: http://localhost:3002 -> localhost:3002 (identical to the old hardcoded value, so the compose integration CI path stays green); https://snap.example.com/x -> snap.example.com. All 12 mklink payloads use $LINK_DOMAIN; zero hardcoded localhost:3002 in payloads. `trap cleanup EXIT` installed (line 164) before the first mklink (line 175). pnpm type-check/test SKIPPED: node/pnpm not runnable in this sandbox and no app code changed; the composed end-to-end run is re-validated by the CI `integration` job on the PR (which runs smoke-redirect.sh against the container stack with DATABASE_URL set). Test quality: the always-run country-population check drives a real redirect (non-bot UA + CloudFront-Viewer-Country: IN) and polls the real GET /analytics breakdown for ~90s -- it exercises the actual click->rollup->analytics chain and would fail if country population regressed; nothing is mocked. The reusable smoke-deployed.yml cannot be fully exercised until Phase 7 (#288/#289) provides a deploy target; it is syntactically valid and documented as such.
